D: Oil drillers are sent into space to blow up an asteroid heading for Earth.
P: Serve dessert when AJ does the animal cracker scene.
S: AJ and Grace's honey animal crackers
the most famous animal crackers in movie history

Crisp honey and vanilla butter biscuits cut into little animals, baked golden and served by the bowlful, ready for a walk up someone's arm. Beat 125g butter with 80g sugar and 2 tbsp honey, then mix in 250g flour. Roll thin and cut with small animal cutters. Bake at 170C for 10 minutes until pale golden. Cool on a rack and pile into a bowl.
Harry's rig in the middle of the ocean
Topside sliced thin, marinated in soy, black pepper and brown sugar, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
M: Oil rig chuck chilli with cornbread

Beef chuck chunks braised with onion, garlic, chilli, cumin, tomato and kidney beans until tender, with sour cream and warm buttered cornbread. Brown 1.2kg beef chuck in 3cm chunks in batches. Add 2 diced onions and 4 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes, then 2 tbsp chilli powder, 2 tsp cumin and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 800g crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock, cover and braise at 150C for 2.5 hours. Stir in a drained 400g tin kidney beans for the last 20 minutes. Bake cornbread mix in a hot buttered pan at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream.
steak, mash and gravy before launch
Rib eye seared and rested, buttery mash and onion gravy (onions cooked down, flour, beef stock).
W: Animal crackers dipped in melted pink and white candy melts with sprinkles, served with a bowl of whipped cream.
K: the crew's list of demands before launch

Bourbon over ice topped with spicy ginger beer, fresh lime and a dash of bitters, served long and cold in heavy highball glasses. Fill 4 highball glasses with ice. Add 45ml bourbon and the juice of a quarter lime to each, plus a dash of aromatic bitters. Top each with 150ml cold ginger beer and stir once from the bottom. Garnish with a lime wedge.

s.how: Slice 600g beef topside 3mm thick across the grain. Marinate overnight in 80ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tsp cracked black pepper. Lay on racks and dry at 70C with the oven door ajar for 4 hours until leathery but bendy.

m.note: steak, mash and gravy before launch
m.how: Mash 1kg potatoes with 80g butter and milk. Cook 2 sliced onions in butter for 20 minutes, stir in 1 tbsp flour and add 400ml beef stock, then simmer. Sear 4 rib eyes hard, rest 5 minutes and pour the gravy over.

w.how: Make a batch of animal biscuits from 125g butter, 80g sugar and 250g flour, baked at 170C for 10 minutes. Dip each half into 250g melted pink or white candy melts and add sprinkles. Serve with a bowl of 300ml whipped cream.
